description.zh: 列表当前页号， 大于等于1。
description.en: The page number. The value must be greater than or equal to 1.

description.zh: 查询结束时间, 单位毫秒。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

description.zh:
事件生成方式。 取值：
- default:默认内置方式
- singleToSingle：每个告警生成一个事件
- allToSingle：周期内告警生成一个事件
description.en:
The event generation method. Valid values:

- default: the default built-in method

- singleToSingle: An event is generated for each alert.

- allToSingle: An event is generated for all alerts in an epoch.

description.zh:
事件列表排列方向。 取值：
- desc：降序排列
- asc：升序排列。
description.en:
The sort order. Valid values:

- desc: descending

- asc: ascending

description.zh:
规则列表排列字段。 取值：
- GmtModified：基于修改时间排序
- Id：基于规则id排序（默认）
description.en:
The field to sort the rules by. Valid values:

- GmtModified: Sorts by modification time.

- Id: Sorts by rule ID. This is the default value.

description.zh: 列表每页条数， 最大不超过100。
description.en: The number of entries per page. The maximum value is 100.

description.zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
- cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
- ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
description.en:
The region where the Data Management center of the threat analysis feature is located. Select the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: assets in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong)

- ap-southeast-1: assets outside China

description.zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID。
description.en: The user ID that the administrator uses to switch to the perspective of a member.

description.zh:
视图类型。

- 0：当前阿里云账号视图。
- 1：企业下所有账号的视图。
description.en:
The view type.

- 0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: the view of all accounts in the enterprise.

description.zh: 规则名称, 仅支持字母、数字、下划线、点。
description.en: The rule name. The name can contain only letters, digits, underscores (\_), and periods (.).

description.zh:
规则类型。 取值：
- predefine：预定义
- customize：自定义
description.en:
The rule type. Valid values:

- predefine: predefined

- customize: custom

description.zh: 查询开始时间, 单位毫秒。
description.en: The start of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

description.zh:
规则状态。 取值：
- 0：初始状态
- 10：模拟数据测试
- 15：业务数据测试中
- 20：业务数据测试结束
- 100：规则上线
description.en:
The rule status. Valid values:

- 0: initial

- 10: testing with simulated data

- 15: testing with production data

- 20: testing with production data is complete

- 100: published

description.zh:
威胁等级，格式为json数组。取值：
- serious：高危
- suspicious：中危
- remind：低危
description.en:
The threat level. The value is a JSON array. Valid values:

- serious: high

- suspicious: medium

- remind: low

example.legacyCli: aliyun cloud-siem ListCloudSiemPredefinedRules --region cn-hangzhou --Status 0 --Order desc --AttCk 'T1595.002_Vulnerability_Scanning' --EndTime 1577808000000 --PageSize 10 --RoleType 1 --StartTime 1577808000000 --RuleType customize --OrderField Id --AlertType scan --LogSource cloud_siem_alb_flow_log --CurrentPage 1 --EventTransferType allToSingle --RoleFor 1130916744880000 --Id 10223 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --RuleName waf_scan --ThreatLevel.1 remind
